title: FOLDTRACE: structure-first search and active-site mapping across protein folds
description: A tool implementing a two-stage, structure-first workflow. Stage 1 (foldtrace search) searches a Foldseek database, e.g. the AlphaFold/UniProt50 set, by fold and returns a ranked hit table. Stage 2 (foldtrace map) superposes each candidate on a reference with TM-align and reads every chemistry-defining position as retained, altered, lost, or unresolved using an order-aware residue correspondence; unresolved calls carry an explicit reason. foldtrace run chains the two stages. Version 0.2.0 completes both stages, with a worked TIR (SARM1 NADase) example. The concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.22081699 always resolves to the latest version; each release receives its own version DOI.
